service.description: New passport (normal) applied on Passport Seva; the customer visits the Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) on the appointment date, and the passport comes by Speed Post after police verification.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card, proof of date of birth (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), address proof, mobile number and email ID
service.rules: The customer must take all original documents to the PSK. Give the appointment slip (ARN) to the customer.
